title: Not worth the price
text: Not worth the price. This item did not power on as it should. When it did, it was very loud in a quiet room. Also, the tilt up was poor. I returned it. Poor value at $20.

product_metadata.title: Holmes 8-Inch Fan | Lil’ Blizzard Oscillating Table Fan, Black
features: Tilt-adjustable head allows you to direct airflow wherever you want it
Removable front grill for easy cleaning
Ideal for small rooms up to 155 sq. ft.
description: Create a blizzard of coolness with the specially designed motor and blade combination of the Holmes Lil' Blizzard Performance Table Fan that propels powerful airflow and generates cooling comfort. With two speed settings and an adjustable tilt-head for directing airflow more precisely and providing maximum effectiveness. Oscillation disperses cool air out to cover a wide area in small rooms. Because it operates in a quiet mode, it's ideal for tabletop use in any room. Removable front grill is easy to clean. 1-year limited warranty. Recommended Location:Indoor
